name: Straight
overview: The biblical concept of 'straight' encompasses both literal and figurative meanings, emphasizing the preparation of a clear and direct path for the Lord, as seen in Isaiah 40:3-4 and Matthew 3:3, where valleys are exalted and crooked places made straight to symbolize righteousness. In Acts 9:11, 'Straight' is also the name of a street in Damascus, highlighting the tangible reality of this term in Scripture. Hebrews 12:13 encourages believers to make straight paths for their feet, illustrating the practical application of living righteously to avoid stumbling and promote spiritual healing.
